gr-0HUg.title: Landscape: big flat farm valleys, north
gr-0HUg.summary: The largest flat farming valleys are near the two big northern cities. Smaller flat valleys, with mountains looking closer, appear elsewhere in the north and centre.

gr-1EYq.title: Landscape: barren island, bushes no trees
gr-1EYq.summary: Many central islands are barren, with small bushes and no trees. Most common on the smaller islands with coverage.

gr-2vBM.title: Marker: blue km post, two alphabets
gr-2vBM.summary: Blue kilometre markers with 'km' on the left written in both Latin and Greek letters.

gr-4veg.title: Phone numbers: area code starts with 2
gr-4veg.summary: Area codes always begin with 2, followed by 1 to 3 digits for the area. A third digit of 1 means the region's biggest city, 9 means the area around it.

gr-9EGM.title: Pole: five vertical insulators
gr-9EGM.summary: Many poles carry five upright insulators, attached either to the pole or to the metal frame of the previous top.

gr-9dRJ.title: Sign: pedestrian sign, two dotted lines
gr-9dRJ.summary: Pedestrian crossing signs show two dotted horizontal lines rather than vertical stripes.

gr-D0RT.title: Soil: red dirt
gr-D0RT.summary: Red dirt is very common. Albania also has a lot of it.

gr-EurJ.title: Taxis: yellow with a blue stripe
gr-EurJ.summary: Yellow taxis, with a blue stripe around the car, are found in the capital.

gr-IAgW.title: Plants: citrus plantations on the south coast
gr-IAgW.summary: Citrus groves along the coast, especially in the south of the southern peninsula.

gr-LYqE.title: Landscape: tallest mountains in the west
gr-LYqE.summary: The tallest mountains are in the western half and hold most of the high mountain roads with coverage.

gr-LaWJ.title: Landscape: lone mountain south of a flat valley
gr-LaWJ.summary: A single solitary mountain, not a range, sitting south of a flat farming valley.

gr-LomS.title: Pole: side lamp with round shade
gr-LomS.summary: A small lamp on the side of the pole with a round shade above the bulb. North Macedonia and Serbia have it too.

gr-Mulx.title: Sign: blue arrow signs, yellow local text
gr-Mulx.summary: Blue arrow-shaped direction signs. Place names are in Greek letters in yellow and in English in white.

gr-NfLS.title: Google car: antenna with slight bulge at tip
gr-NfLS.summary: On the big southern island you may see a car antenna with a slight bulge at its tip.

gr-OXmC.title: Landscape: very mountainous, winding roads
gr-OXmC.summary: Very mountainous, and much of the coverage is on winding mountain roads.

gr-OinI.title: Houses: white and pastel, orange roofs
gr-OinI.summary: White and pastel stone houses with orange tile roofs, with more white than in most Mediterranean countries. City blocks are multi-storey with linked balconies. White-and-blue houses are mainly on islands.

gr-OrNT.title: Coverage: many islands, not all covered
gr-OrNT.summary: Many small islands, some with coverage and some without. The mainland and the biggest island have all three camera generations, most other islands do not.

gr-P33J.title: Bollard: wedge shape, squarish reflectors
gr-P33J.summary: Wedge-shaped bollard with almost square reflectors, red on the front and white on the back.

gr-PD64.title: Google car: low Gen 4 'smallcam'
gr-PD64.summary: Gen 4 camera mounted lower than usual, with a big round blur and a small bump at the front. The blur can be fully see-through.

gr-Pz7M.title: Language: unique rounded alphabet
gr-Pz7M.summary: A unique alphabet with softer lowercase letters than Cyrillic. Cyprus also uses it, but drives on the left.

gr-UvYA.title: Chevron: white arrows on black
gr-UvYA.summary: White arrows on a black background. Albania, Italy and the UK use similar ones. Spain has the same colours but almost always two or four arrows.

differs.how: Spanish chevrons have two or four arrows

gr-W9N2.title: Road lines: yellow lines
gr-W9N2.summary: Yellow road lines are more common here than in any other southern European country.

gr-ZlI6.title: Sign: warning sign, red border, yellow fill
gr-ZlI6.summary: Warning signs have a red border and a yellow background.

gr-czh8.title: Plants: olive plantations, coast and south
gr-czh8.summary: Olive groves along the coast, especially on the big southern island and in the southern part of the southern peninsula.

gr-gSZ9.title: Coverage: bleak Gen 3 winter and autumn
gr-gSZ9.summary: Lots of Gen 3 coverage taken in winter and autumn, looking bleak and grey.

gr-gZjk.title: Houses: all white with blue doors and shutters
gr-gZjk.summary: Completely white houses with blue doors and shutters, mainly on the small central islands.

gr-iK1n.title: Pole: tall dark brown wood
gr-iK1n.summary: Utility poles are mostly wooden, often dark brown and noticeably taller than elsewhere.

gr-iTtu.title: Skyline: many very tall rooftop antennas
gr-iTtu.summary: In the northern big city you often see lots of unusually tall antennas on top of buildings.

gr-lm-2993.title: Sign: detailed pedestrian figure, no hat
gr-lm-2993.summary: Several countries have horizontal stripes on pedestrian signs. Here the figure is detailed and hatless. The hair can look like a hat but is just hair.

differs.how: Poland's sign is a single continuous line

gr-lm-474150.title: Pole: wooden crossbar top
gr-lm-474150.summary: Many poles end in a wooden crossbar at the top.

gr-lm-740403.title: Street sign: extra panel under the name
gr-lm-740403.summary: The capital's street signs have an extra panel under the main street name.

gr-mBGi.title: Landscape: tall rock pillars with monasteries
gr-mBGi.summary: Extraordinary monolithic rock towers (Meteora), found north of Trikala.

gr-nWCE.title: Taxis: blue with white roof
gr-nWCE.summary: Blue taxis with a white roof are found in the second city, in the north.

gr-rFeU.title: Plate: all white or EU style, yellow taxis
gr-rFeU.summary: Plates are either all white or the standard European style with a blue strip on the left. Taxis have yellow plates.

gr-stIX.title: Pole: harp-shaped metal top
gr-stIX.summary: Pole tops with a metal frame shaped roughly like a harp. Only found here and in Cyprus.

gr-t5zz.title: Road lines: faded solid white double middle
gr-t5zz.summary: Slightly faded, solid white double middle lines. This separates it from most other Mediterranean countries.

gr-uCkV.title: Roadside: miniature churches on pedestals
gr-uCkV.summary: Tiny churches on small pedestals often stand by the road, and are unique to this country.

gr-ui2d.title: Sign: town entry, blue bars top and bottom
gr-ui2d.summary: Town entry signs are white with thick horizontal blue stripes at the top and bottom.
